subject: geography
title: Economic Development Adventure: Foundations
welcome_lead: How do we measure how 'developed' a country is — and why do some race ahead of others?
meta_desc: GCSE Geography development indicators — HIC, NEE, LIC, GDP, HDI, infant mortality.
final_note: You learned the main development categories and indicators used to compare countries.

walkthroughs.body_html:
The World Bank groups countries by income:

HIC: wealthy, mostly tertiary/quaternary jobs (UK, USA).
NEE: rapid industrial growth (Brazil, China, India, Nigeria).
LIC: low income, mostly primary jobs (Malawi, Burundi).

GDP per capita: total output divided by population. UK ≈ $46,000; Malawi ≈ $580.

Limits: ignores inequality and hidden informal economy.

Life expectancy: UK ~81, Chad ~53.

Infant mortality: UK ~4 per 1000, Afghanistan ~58 per 1000.

HDI combines income, life expectancy and education into a single 0-1 score. Norway tops the list at ~0.96; HICs are usually >0.8.

mcqs.q: Why is HDI a better measure of development than GNI per capita?
options: Because HDI is easier to calculate than GNI.
HDI combines income, life expectancy and education, capturing quality of life — GNI per capita is just average income and hides inequality and non-economic wellbeing.
Because HDI measures how happy people are.
The Brandt Line is the boundary between the Atlantic and Pacific oceans.
Because HDI is easier to calculate than GNI.
Sustainable development means stopping all economic growth.
Sustainable development means using only solar power.
Development that meets the needs of the present without compromising the ability of future generations to meet their own needs — balancing economic, social and environmental goals.

mcqs.q: Why is the Brandt Line considered outdated?
options: Drawn in 1980, it predates the rise of NICs (China, India, Brazil) and globalisation — countries like South Korea, Singapore and Chile no longer fit neatly on the 'poor south' side.
The Brandt Line still accurately divides rich and poor countries today.
Because HDI is easier to calculate than GNI.
The Brandt Line is the boundary between the Atlantic and Pacific oceans.
